summary: The filing is a Form 6-K containing a press release for Arcos Dorados Holdings Inc.'s first quarter 2026 financial results. It reports total revenue of $1.2 billion (up 12.9% YoY), systemwide comparable sales growth of 16.0%, consolidated Adjusted EBITDA of $118.0 million (up 29.3% YoY), and net income of $36.1 million or $0.17 per share (up from $0.07 per share last year). It also notes the opening of 19 new restaurants. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is referenced. The CEO provides context on growth since 2019, but the filing is purely an earnings update with no special-situation catalyst.
